question: What is the most unhinged thing a coworker ever got away with?
story: My coworker ran a full barbershop out of our supply closet for two years, and the company gave him an award for it. His name was Dennis. He worked in shipping. Around March he started disappearing for twenty minutes at a time and coming back smelling like aftershave. Then guys from the warehouse started showing up to meetings with fresh fades. Twenty five dollars, cash, no appointment, in a room full of printer paper. He had a mirror taped to a shelf and a folding chair. Management noticed something too. Morale was up. Attendance was up. People were staying late for no reason. So at the holiday party they handed Dennis the Culture Champion award and a hundred dollar gift card. He accepted it wearing a barber cape. Here is the twist. HR finally found the closet in January. They did not shut it down. They gave him a bigger room.
